title: Rollback & Downgrade Boundary
objective: Mendokumentasikan apa yang dapat di-rollback, apa yang tidak, dan jalur ekspor aman untuk downgrade.

outputs.rollback_test: Current-schema backup is restored into a disposable alternate package and verified without changing the live package.
outputs.downgrade_limits: Newer schema is blocked; older schema may only migrate forward through the production open path.
outputs.safe_export: A JSON downgrade-safe export carries manifest, base64 database, and base64 asset payloads without writing to the live package.
outputs.user_warnings: Future-schema rollback returns explicit warnings and leaves the probe destination empty.
outputs.support_procedure: Six ordered support actions cover close, inspect, no manual edits, export/upgrade, interrupted restore, and escalation copy.

fixture_policy: Synthetic disposable package and backup under the OS temp directory; no user project is read or modified.
limits: This slice verifies local service behavior only.
Native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain outside this evidence.
